help.title: Help Center
help.q1Title: How do I find and book a provider?
help.q1Body: Tap Find a pro, filter by category or your location, open a provider's profile you like, then tap Book and pick an available time slot.
help.q2Body: There's no in-app payment. The customer and provider agree on a price and pay each other directly after the job is done.
help.q3Title: When do we see each other's contact info?
help.q3Body: Phone number and LINE ID are only shared once the provider has confirmed the booking, to keep both sides safe.
help.q4Body: Yes, while it's still pending or confirmed. A cancellation reason is always required.
help.q5Title: How do I become a provider?
help.q5Body: Choose the provider role when you sign up, or upgrade later from your dashboard. Then submit verification documents to get a verified badge.

contact.title: Contact Us
contact.body: Have a question or ran into an issue? Reach our team at the email below. We usually reply within 1-2 business days.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: By using this platform, you agree to the terms below.
terms.s1Body: This platform connects customers with independent service providers. We are not the providers' employer and aren't directly responsible for the quality of their work.
terms.s2Body: You must provide accurate information when signing up and are responsible for keeping your account secure.
terms.s3Body: Payment happens directly between the customer and the provider, outside the platform. We are not involved in charges or refunds.
terms.s4Body: Both parties should agree on cancellation terms before the job starts. If a dispute arises, we may help coordinate but we don't act as an arbiter.
terms.s5Body: We make a reasonable effort to review submitted verification documents, but we don't guarantee the quality of work or any resulting damages.
terms.s6Body: We may update these terms from time to time. Continuing to use the platform after a change means you accept the new terms.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This policy explains how we collect and use your information.
privacy.s1Body: Your name, phone number, email, approximate location, profile photo, and the booking/chat data you create on the platform.
privacy.s2Body: To match customers with providers, verify identity, show search results, and improve the service.
privacy.s3Body: Your phone number and LINE ID are only shared with the other party once the provider has confirmed the booking.
privacy.s4Body: Photos and documents are served through time-limited, authorization-checked URLs -- never publicly accessible.
privacy.s5Body: You can request to correct or delete your account data by contacting our team.
privacy.s6Body: If you have questions about your personal data, reach us at the email on the Contact page.
